title: Inter: Barella left at Coverciano as Bastoni, Dimarco and Esposito fly to Bursa
description:
Italy lost at home on Friday. Barella is one of ten players Mancini left behind.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=27

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Roberto Mancini left ten players at Coverciano instead of taking them to Bursa; Nicolo Barella is one of them, while Alessandro Bastoni, Federico Dimarco and Francesco Pio Esposito are in the traveling squad (FIGC via ANSA, Sep 27).
REPORTED — Chelsea have made Bastoni their first choice for the left of a back three, with Inter's asking price about £70 million and no talks between the clubs (TEAMtalk via FCInterNews, Sep 27).
